records.title: FORM 10-K
records.text: Our total revenue was $683.0 million, $365.6 million and $294.5 million for the years ended December 31, 2020, 2019 and 2018, respectively.

records.title: FORM 10-K
records.text: The new Polaris™ PAM4 DSP now includes products supporting an integrated driver to address the growing demands for lower power and reduced cost solutions over short reach data center optical connectivity.

records.title: FORM 10-K
records.text: Our accounts payable and inventories increased due to build-up of inventories for future shipments and addition of eSilicon inventories.

records.title: FORM 10-K
records.text: ● Total operating expenses increased by $125.7 million, or 48% to $388.0 million.

records.title: FORM 10-K
records.text: Cash provided by operating activities was $155.6 million during the year ended December 31, 2020 compared to $96.9 million during the year ended December 31, 2019.
